newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Okasan International to shut Bahrain office.
newsitem.headline: Okasan International to shut Bahrain office.

text.p: Okasan International, an investment bank based in Bahrain, said it would close down its Manama office by the end of June.
"The bank is closing down," a company official told Reuters. "The bank will stop doing business and it will be officially closed by June 30, 1997," he added.
"The bank will be liquidated. It has cleared the way with the Bahraini authorities to close down," another official said.
The bank's director of administration and finance T. Nozaki would not give any details, but bankers said it was 51 percent owned by Okasan Securities of Japan.
Financial institutions in Bahrain and Kuwait and Marubeni International Finance Plc held the remaining stake, they added.
Bankers said business at the bank, which had 14 staff, had not been good, which prompted it to close its doors.
